_note: level_zoom: zoom at which a click starts to choose ADM1 and ADM2 units. The build never lets a value go below the minzoom of the boundary tiles of that level (ADM1 2, ADM2 4 at the time of writing): it prints a warning and raises it. world_zoom: below this zoom a click on the globe chooses the whole world. fan_max: a place with more records than this opens as a list only, with no fan. default_view.country: an ISO3 code to open on a country, null for the world.
